proves.claim: At the board-release-codes engine a queued gate that finishes refused with returnToBoard set, reached through completeSubmitHandoff, leaves the item open with no owner and writes a release event with reasonCode GATE_REFUSED and the reason text unchanged.

store.handoff-retry.gate-refused-code.why: Board-written releases are counted by closed code; a gate refusal returned to the board as OTHER hides why claims return.

proves.claim: Below the board-release-codes engine the same returned release still carries reasonCode OTHER with the same text, so older boards replay unchanged.

store.handoff-retry.gate-refused-code-be.why: A board below the engine must replay its history exactly as before.
